# routeur_classifier_rule (Resource)

A classifier rule in a workspace. It fires when the auto-router's classifier score on one axis (toxicity, coding, …) reaches `min_score`, and then logs, flags or blocks the prompt.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "routeur_workspace" "support" {
  slug = "support"
  name = "Support"
}

# Reject prompts the classifier scores as weapons-related at 0.85 or above.
resource "routeur_classifier_rule" "no_weapons" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.support.id
  slug         = "no_weapons"
  name         = "No weapons"
  axis         = "weapons"
  min_score    = 0.85
  action       = "block"
}

# Only report coding prompts.
resource "routeur_classifier_rule" "coding" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.support.id
  slug         = "coding"
  name         = "Coding"
  axis         = "coding"
  min_score    = 0.5
  action       = "log"
  enabled      = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `log` or `flag` only report; `block` rejects the prompt with HTTP 403.
- `axis` (String) The classifier score the rule reads: `toxicity`, `hate`, `violence`, `weapons`, `coding`, `long_reasoning`, `large_context`, `structured_output` or `creative`.
- `min_score` (Number) Fires when the score on `axis` is greater than or equal to this value, between 0 and 1.
- `name` (String) Unique in the workspace, 1–80 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `slug` (String) Machine identifier, unique in the workspace: lowercase letters and digits joined by single underscores, at most 64 characters. It can be changed in place.
- `workspace_id` (String) Id of the workspace this belongs to (`ws_…`), e.g. `routeur_workspace.example.id`. The `routeur_workspace` data source resolves a slug to its id. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is evaluated. Defaults to `true`; removing the argument enables the rule again.
- `project_id` (String) Scope the rule to one project in this workspace (`proj_…`). Omit it to apply to every project in the workspace. Changing it updates the rule in place.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) Public id of the rule (`clf_…`).
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# id: <workspace_id>/<classifier_rule_id>
import {
  to = routeur_classifier_rule.no_weapons
  id = "ws_3/clf_12"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <workspace_id>/<classifier_rule_id>
terraform import routeur_classifier_rule.no_weapons ws_3/clf_12
```
